import Mathlib

inductive Node where
  | nil
  | node (val : Nat) (left : Node) (right : Node)
deriving Inhabited, Repr

open Node

def view (t : Node) : Set Nat :=
  match t with
  | nil => ∅
  | node v l r => {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r

def tree_contains (t : Node) (target : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | nil => false
  | node v l r => v == target || tree_contains l target || tree_contains r target

def tree_distinct (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | nil => True
  | node v l r =>
      tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧
      v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
      (view l ∩ view r = ∅)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_precond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  tree_contains root p ∧ tree_contains root q ∧ tree_distinct root
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def aux (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Option Nat × Bool × Bool :=
  match root with
  | nil => (none, false, false)
  | node val l r =>
      let (lcaL, hasPL, hasQL) := aux l p q
      let (lcaR, hasPR, hasQR) := aux r p q
      let hasP := (val == p) || hasPL || hasPR
      let hasQ := (val == q) || hasQL || hasQR
      let lca :=
        if lcaL.isSome then lcaL
        else if lcaR.isSome then lcaR
        else if hasP && hasQ then some val else none
      (lca, hasP, hasQ)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def lowest_common_ancestor (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (aux root p q).1
  -- !benchmark @end code

def is_ancestor (root : Node) (anc target : Nat) : Prop :=
  match root with
  | nil => False
  | node v l r =>
      if v = anc then tree_contains (node v l r) target = true
      else is_ancestor l anc target ∨ is_ancestor r anc target

-- ADDED: Helper to determine depth for the "Lowest" check
def get_depth (root : Node) (target : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match root with
  | nil => none
  | node v l r =>
      if v == target then some 0
      else
        match get_depth l target, get_depth r target with
        | some d, _ => some (d + 1)
        | none, some d => some (d + 1)
        | none, none => none

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_postcond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some lca =>
      -- 1. Validity: It is a common ancestor
      is_ancestor root lca p ∧
      is_ancestor root lca q ∧
      -- 2. Optimality: It is the LOWEST (Deepest) common ancestor
      (∀ x, is_ancestor root x p → is_ancestor root x q →
         match get_depth root x, get_depth root lca with
         | some dx, some dres => dx ≤ dres
         | _, _ => True) -- Should imply dx and dres exist if is_ancestor is true
  | none => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem lca_tree_contains_nil (x : Nat) : tree_contains nil x = false := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_contains]; done)
  | (unfold tree_contains; rfl)

theorem lca_tree_contains_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x : Nat) :
    tree_contains (node v l r) x = ((v == x) || tree_contains l x || tree_contains r x) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_contains]; done)
  | (unfold tree_contains; rfl)

theorem lca_view_nil : view nil = (∅ : Set Nat) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [view]; done)
  | (unfold view; rfl)

theorem lca_view_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) :
    view (node v l r) = {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [view]; done)
  | (unfold view; rfl)

theorem lca_is_ancestor_nil (x y : Nat) : is_ancestor nil x y ↔ False := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [is_ancestor]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_is_ancestor_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x y : Nat) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y ↔
      (if v = x then tree_contains (node v l r) y = true
       else is_ancestor l x y ∨ is_ancestor r x y) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [is_ancestor]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_tree_distinct_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) :
    tree_distinct (node v l r) ↔
      (tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧ v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
        (view l ∩ view r = ∅)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_distinct]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_get_depth_nil (x : Nat) : get_depth nil x = none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [get_depth]; done)
  | (unfold get_depth; rfl)

theorem lca_get_depth_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : get_depth (node v l r) v = some 0 := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth])
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp)
  | rfl

theorem lca_get_depth_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (h : get_depth l x = some d) : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, h])
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, h])

theorem lca_get_depth_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (h : get_depth r x = some d) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, hl, h])
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, hl, h])

theorem lca_get_depth_none' {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (hr : get_depth r x = none) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = none := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, hl, hr])
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, hl, hr])

theorem lca_aux_nil (p q : Nat) : aux nil p q = (none, false, false) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [aux]; done)
  | (unfold aux; rfl)

theorem lca_aux_nil_fst (p q : Nat) : (aux nil p q).1 = none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (rw [lca_aux_nil])
  | (simp [lca_aux_nil])

theorem lca_aux_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    aux (node v l r) p q =
      ((if ((aux l p q).1).isSome then (aux l p q).1
        else if ((aux r p q).1).isSome then (aux r p q).1
        else if (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                 ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) then some v else none),
       ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1),
       ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [aux]
     generalize aux l p q = tl
     generalize aux r p q = tr
     obtain ⟨a1, b1, c1⟩ := tl
     obtain ⟨a2, b2, c2⟩ := tr
     rfl)
  | (simp [aux]; done)

theorem lca_aux_fst (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 =
      (if ((aux l p q).1).isSome then (aux l p q).1
       else if ((aux r p q).1).isSome then (aux r p q).1
       else if (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) then some v else none) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasP_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).2.1 = ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasQ_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).2.2 = ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasP (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.1 = tree_contains t p := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasP_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_aux_hasQ (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.2 = tree_contains t q := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasQ_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_mem_view_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : v ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]; simp

theorem lca_mem_view_left {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view l) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)

theorem lca_mem_view_right {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view r) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_mem_view_cases {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view (node v l r)) :
    x = v ∨ x ∈ view l ∨ x ∈ view r := by
  rw [lca_view_node] at h
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
  tauto

theorem lca_contains_of_mem (t : Node) (x : Nat) : x ∈ view t → tree_contains t x = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihl h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihr h']; simp

theorem lca_mem_of_contains (t : Node) (x : Nat) : tree_contains t x = true → x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at h
    by_cases h1 : v = x
    · rw [← h1]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · by_cases h2 : tree_contains l x = true
      · exact lca_mem_view_left (ihl h2)
      · have e1 : (v == x) = false := by simp [h1]
        have e2 : tree_contains l x = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l x with
          | false => rfl
          | true => exact absurd hc h2
        rw [e1, e2] at h
        have h3 : tree_contains r x = true := by simpa using h
        exact lca_mem_view_right (ihr h3)

theorem lca_is_ancestor_mem (t : Node) (x y : Nat) :
    is_ancestor t x y → x ∈ view t ∧ y ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    exact ((lca_is_ancestor_nil x y).mp h).elim
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · rw [if_pos hv] at h
      refine ⟨?_, lca_mem_of_contains _ y h⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · rw [if_neg hv] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_left h1, lca_mem_view_left h2⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_right h1, lca_mem_view_right h2⟩

theorem lca_is_ancestor_left {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor l x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_left (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inl h

theorem lca_is_ancestor_right {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor r x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_right (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_get_depth_isSome (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ view t → ∃ d, get_depth t x = some d := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
    · rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
      · exact absurd h'.symm hv
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihl h'
        exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hd⟩
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihr h'
        cases hlx : get_depth l x with
        | some dl => exact ⟨dl + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hlx⟩
        | none => exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_right hv hlx hd⟩

theorem lca_get_depth_eq_none (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∉ view t → get_depth t x = none := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro _; exact lca_get_depth_nil x
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    have h1 : ¬ (v = x) := by
      intro hv
      exact h (by rw [← hv]; exact lca_mem_view_self v l r)
    have h2 : x ∉ view l := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_left hh)
    have h3 : x ∉ view r := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_right hh)
    exact lca_get_depth_none' h1 (ihl h2) (ihr h3)

theorem lca_band_left {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_band_right {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_aux_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat} (h : (aux l p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat}
    (hA : (aux l p q).1 = none) (h : (aux r p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_isSome_of (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_contains t p = true → tree_contains t q = true → ∃ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro hp _
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at hp
    exact absurd hp (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hp hq
    cases hA : (aux l p q).1 with
    | some a => exact ⟨a, lca_aux_left hA⟩
    | none =>
      cases hB : (aux r p q).1 with
      | some b => exact ⟨b, lca_aux_right hA hB⟩
      | none =>
        have hcond : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                      ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true := by
          rw [lca_aux_hasP l p q, lca_aux_hasP r p q, lca_aux_hasQ l p q, lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at hp hq
          rw [hp, hq]
          simp
        refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
        rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, hB, hcond]
        simp

theorem lca_aux_cases (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q a : Nat)
    (h : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux l p q).1 = some a ∨ (aux r p q).1 = some a ∨
      (a = v ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) p = true ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) q = true) := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst] at h
  by_cases h1 : ((aux l p q).1).isSome = true
  · rw [if_pos h1] at h
    exact Or.inl h
  · rw [if_neg h1] at h
    by_cases h2 : ((aux r p q).1).isSome = true
    · rw [if_pos h2] at h
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rw [if_neg h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                     ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3] at h
        refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by simpa using h.symm, ?_, ?_⟩)
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasP l p q, ← lca_aux_hasP r p q]
          exact lca_band_left h3
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasQ l p q, ← lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          exact lca_band_right h3
      · rw [if_neg h3] at h
        exact absurd h (by simp)

theorem lca_aux_ancestor (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    ∀ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a → is_ancestor t a p ∧ is_ancestor t a q := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro a h
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro a h
    rcases lca_aux_cases v l r p q a h with hc | hc | ⟨hav, hcp, hcq⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_left h1, lca_is_ancestor_left h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_right h1, lca_is_ancestor_right h2⟩
    · constructor
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcp
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcq

theorem lca_aux_lowest (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_distinct t → ∀ a x dx da, (aux t p q).1 = some a →
      is_ancestor t x p → is_ancestor t x q →
      get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t a = some da → dx ≤ da := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro _ a x dx da h _ _ _ _
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hdist a x dx da hlca hxp hxq hdx hda
    rw [lca_tree_distinct_node] at hdist
    obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hdist
    have hdisj : ∀ y, y ∈ view l → y ∈ view r → False := by
      intro y hy1 hy2
      have hmem : y ∈ view l ∩ view r := Set.mem_inter hy1 hy2
      rw [hlr] at hmem
      simp at hmem
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · have h0 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some 0 := by
        rw [← hv]
        exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
      rw [h0] at hdx
      have hdx0 : 0 = dx := by simpa using hdx
      omega
    · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at hxp hxq
      rw [if_neg hv] at hxp hxq
      rcases hxp with hxp | hxp
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · have hxl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1
          have hpl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).2
          have hql := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).2
          obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of l p q
            (lca_contains_of_mem l p hpl) (lca_contains_of_mem l q hql)
          have hlca' : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a' := lca_aux_left ha'
          rw [hlca] at hlca'
          have haa : a = a' := by simpa using hlca'
          have hal := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l a' p (lca_aux_ancestor l p q a' ha').1).1
          obtain ⟨dx', hdx'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l x hxl
          obtain ⟨da', hda'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l a' hal
          have e1 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (dx' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hv hdx'
          have hva : ¬ (v = a') := by
            intro hvv
            rw [hvv] at hvl
            exact hvl hal
          have e2 : get_depth (node v l r) a' = some (da' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hva hda'
          rw [haa, e2] at hda
          rw [e1] at hdx
          have i1 : dx' + 1 = dx := by simpa using hdx
          have i2 : da' + 1 = da := by simpa using hda
          have i3 := ihl hdl a' x dx' da' ha' hxp hxq hdx' hda'
          omega
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1 hh)
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x hh (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1)
        · have hxr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1
          have hpr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).2
          have hqr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).2
          have hAnone : (aux l p q).1 = none := by
            cases hcase : (aux l p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some c =>
              exfalso

      get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t a = some da → dx ≤ da := by

  | nil => intro _ a x dx da h _ _ _ _; rw [aux_nil_eq] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)

    intro hd a x dx da hlca hxp hxq hdx hda
    rw [tree_distinct_node] at hd
    obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hd
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · -- dx = 0
      have h0 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some 0 := by subst hv; exact get_depth_self _ _ _
      rw [h0] at hdx
      -- hdx : some 0 = some dx
      have : dx = 0 := by simpa using hdx.symm
      omega
    · rw [is_ancestor_node, if_neg hv] at hxp hxq
      -- disjointness helper

        intro y hy1 hy2

      rcases hxp with hxp | hxp
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · -- both left
          have hxl := (is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1
          have hpl := (is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).2
          have hql := (is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).2

import Mathlib

inductive Node where
  | nil
  | node (val : Nat) (left : Node) (right : Node)
deriving Inhabited, Repr

open Node

def view (t : Node) : Set Nat :=
  match t with
  | nil => ∅
  | node v l r => {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r

def tree_contains (t : Node) (target : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | nil => false
  | node v l r => v == target || tree_contains l target || tree_contains r target

  match t with
  | nil => True
  | node v l r =>
      tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧
      v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
      (view l ∩ view r = ∅)

        | some d, _ => some (d + 1)
        | none, some d => some (d + 1)
        | none, none => none

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_postcond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some lca =>
      -- 1. Validity: It is a common ancestor
      is_ancestor root lca p ∧
      is_ancestor root lca q ∧
      -- 2. Optimality: It is the LOWEST (Deepest) common ancestor
      (∀ x, is_ancestor root x p → is_ancestor root x q →
         match get_depth root x, get_depth root lca with
         | some dx, some dres => dx ≤ dres
         | _, _ => True) -- Should imply dx and dres exist if is_ancestor is true
  | none => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem lca_tree_contains_nil (x : Nat) : tree_contains nil x = false := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_contains]; done)
  | (unfold tree_contains; rfl)

theorem lca_tree_contains_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x : Nat) :
    tree_contains (node v l r) x = ((v == x) || tree_contains l x || tree_contains r x) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_contains]; done)
  | (unfold tree_contains; rfl)

theorem lca_view_nil : view nil = (∅ : Set Nat) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [view]; done)
  | (unfold view; rfl)

theorem lca_view_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) :
    view (node v l r) = {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [view]; done)
  | (unfold view; rfl)

theorem lca_is_ancestor_nil (x y : Nat) : is_ancestor nil x y ↔ False := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [is_ancestor]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_is_ancestor_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (x y : Nat) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y ↔
      (if v = x then tree_contains (node v l r) y = true
       else is_ancestor l x y ∨ is_ancestor r x y) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [is_ancestor]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_tree_distinct_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) :
    tree_distinct (node v l r) ↔
      (tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧ v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
        (view l ∩ view r = ∅)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [tree_distinct]; done)
  | exact Iff.rfl

theorem lca_get_depth_nil (x : Nat) : get_depth nil x = none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [get_depth]; done)
  | (unfold get_depth; rfl)

theorem lca_get_depth_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : get_depth (node v l r) v = some 0 := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth]; done)
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp)
  | rfl

theorem lca_get_depth_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (h : get_depth l x = some d) : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, h]; done)
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, h])

theorem lca_get_depth_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (h : get_depth r x = some d) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, hl, h]; done)
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, hl, h])

theorem lca_get_depth_none' {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x : Nat} (hv : ¬ (v = x))
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (hr : get_depth r x = none) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = none := by
  first
  | (simp [get_depth, hv, hl, hr]; done)
  | (rw [get_depth]; simp [hv, hl, hr])

theorem lca_aux_nil (p q : Nat) : aux nil p q = (none, false, false) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [aux]; done)
  | (unfold aux; rfl)

theorem lca_aux_nil_fst (p q : Nat) : (aux nil p q).1 = none := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (rw [lca_aux_nil])
  | (simp [lca_aux_nil])

theorem lca_aux_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    aux (node v l r) p q =
      ((if ((aux l p q).1).isSome then (aux l p q).1
        else if ((aux r p q).1).isSome then (aux r p q).1
        else if (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                 ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) then some v else none),
       ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1),
       ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | (simp only [aux]
     generalize aux l p q = tl
     generalize aux r p q = tr
     obtain ⟨a1, b1, c1⟩ := tl
     obtain ⟨a2, b2, c2⟩ := tr
     rfl)
  | (simp [aux]; done)

theorem lca_aux_fst (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 =
      (if ((aux l p q).1).isSome then (aux l p q).1
       else if ((aux r p q).1).isSome then (aux r p q).1
       else if (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) then some v else none) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasP_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).2.1 = ((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasQ_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).2.2 = ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasP (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.1 = tree_contains t p := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasP_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_aux_hasQ (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.2 = tree_contains t q := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasQ_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_mem_view_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : v ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]; simp

theorem lca_mem_view_left {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view l) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)

theorem lca_mem_view_right {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view r) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_mem_view_cases {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view (node v l r)) :
    x = v ∨ x ∈ view l ∨ x ∈ view r := by
  rw [lca_view_node] at h
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
  tauto

theorem lca_contains_of_mem (t : Node) (x : Nat) : x ∈ view t → tree_contains t x = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihl h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihr h']; simp

theorem lca_mem_of_contains (t : Node) (x : Nat) : tree_contains t x = true → x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at h
    by_cases h1 : v = x
    · rw [← h1]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · by_cases h2 : tree_contains l x = true
      · exact lca_mem_view_left (ihl h2)
      · have e1 : (v == x) = false := by simp [h1]
        have e2 : tree_contains l x = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l x with
          | false => rfl
          | true => exact absurd hc h2
        rw [e1, e2] at h
        have h3 : tree_contains r x = true := by simpa using h
        exact lca_mem_view_right (ihr h3)

theorem lca_is_ancestor_mem (t : Node) (x y : Nat) :
    is_ancestor t x y → x ∈ view t ∧ y ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    exact ((lca_is_ancestor_nil x y).mp h).elim
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · rw [if_pos hv] at h
      refine ⟨?_, lca_mem_of_contains _ y h⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · rw [if_neg hv] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_left h1, lca_mem_view_left h2⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_right h1, lca_mem_view_right h2⟩

theorem lca_is_ancestor_left {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor l x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_left (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inl h

theorem lca_is_ancestor_right {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor r x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_right (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_get_depth_isSome (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ view t → ∃ d, get_depth t x = some d := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
    · rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
      · exact absurd h'.symm hv
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihl h'
        exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hd⟩
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihr h'
        cases hlx : get_depth l x with
        | some dl => exact ⟨dl + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hlx⟩
        | none => exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_right hv hlx hd⟩

theorem lca_get_depth_eq_none (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∉ view t → get_depth t x = none := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro _; exact lca_get_depth_nil x
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    have h1 : ¬ (v = x) := by
      intro hv
      exact h (by rw [← hv]; exact lca_mem_view_self v l r)
    have h2 : x ∉ view l := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_left hh)
    have h3 : x ∉ view r := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_right hh)
    exact lca_get_depth_none' h1 (ihl h2) (ihr h3)

theorem lca_band_left {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_band_right {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_aux_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat} (h : (aux l p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat}
    (hA : (aux l p q).1 = none) (h : (aux r p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_isSome_of (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_contains t p = true → tree_contains t q = true → ∃ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro hp _
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at hp
    exact absurd hp (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hp hq
    cases hA : (aux l p q).1 with
    | some a => exact ⟨a, lca_aux_left hA⟩
    | none =>
      cases hB : (aux r p q).1 with
      | some b => exact ⟨b, lca_aux_right hA hB⟩
      | none =>
        have hcond : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                      ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true := by
          rw [lca_aux_hasP l p q, lca_aux_hasP r p q, lca_aux_hasQ l p q, lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at hp hq
          rw [hp, hq]
        refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
        rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, hB, hcond]
        simp

theorem lca_aux_cases (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q a : Nat)
    (h : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux l p q).1 = some a ∨ (aux r p q).1 = some a ∨
      (a = v ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) p = true ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) q = true) := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst] at h
  by_cases h1 : ((aux l p q).1).isSome = true
  · rw [if_pos h1] at h
    exact Or.inl h
  · rw [if_neg h1] at h
    by_cases h2 : ((aux r p q).1).isSome = true
    · rw [if_pos h2] at h
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rw [if_neg h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                     ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3] at h
        refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by simpa using h.symm, ?_, ?_⟩)
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasP l p q, ← lca_aux_hasP r p q]
          exact lca_band_left h3
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasQ l p q, ← lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          exact lca_band_right h3
      · rw [if_neg h3] at h
        exact absurd h (by simp)

theorem lca_aux_ancestor (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    ∀ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a → is_ancestor t a p ∧ is_ancestor t a q := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro a h
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro a h
    rcases lca_aux_cases v l r p q a h with hc | hc | ⟨hav, hcp, hcq⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_left h1, lca_is_ancestor_left h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_right h1, lca_is_ancestor_right h2⟩
    · constructor
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcp
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcq

theorem lca_aux_lowest (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_distinct t → ∀ a x dx da, (aux t p q).1 = some a →
      is_ancestor t x p → is_ancestor t x q →
      get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t a = some da → dx ≤ da := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro _ a x dx da h _ _ _ _
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hdist a x dx da hlca hxp hxq hdx hda
    rw [lca_tree_distinct_node] at hdist
    obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hdist
    have hdisj : ∀ y, y ∈ view l → y ∈ view r → False := by
      intro y hy1 hy2
      have hmem : y ∈ view l ∩ view r := Set.mem_inter hy1 hy2
      rw [hlr] at hmem
      simp at hmem
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · have h0 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some 0 := by
        rw [← hv]
        exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
      rw [h0] at hdx
      have hdx0 : 0 = dx := by simpa using hdx
      omega
    · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at hxp hxq
      rw [if_neg hv] at hxp hxq
      rcases hxp with hxp | hxp
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · have hxl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1
          have hpl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).2
          have hql := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).2
          obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of l p q
            (lca_contains_of_mem l p hpl) (lca_contains_of_mem l q hql)
          have hlca' : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a' := lca_aux_left ha'
          rw [hlca] at hlca'
          have haa : a = a' := by simpa using hlca'
          have hal := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l a' p (lca_aux_ancestor l p q a' ha').1).1
          obtain ⟨dx', hdx'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l x hxl
          obtain ⟨da', hda'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l a' hal
          have e1 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (dx' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hv hdx'
          have hva : ¬ (v = a') := by
            intro hvv
            rw [hvv] at hvl
            exact hvl hal
          have e2 : get_depth (node v l r) a' = some (da' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hva hda'
          rw [haa, e2] at hda
          rw [e1] at hdx
          have i1 : dx' + 1 = dx := by simpa using hdx
          have i2 : da' + 1 = da := by simpa using hda
          have i3 := ihl hdl a' x dx' da' ha' hxp hxq hdx' hda'
          omega
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1 hh)
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x hh (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1)
        · have hxr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1
          have hpr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).2
          have hqr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).2
          have hAnone : (aux l p q).1 = none := by
            cases hcase : (aux l p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some c =>
              exfalso
              have hcl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l c p (lca_aux_ancestor l p q c hcase).1).2
              exact hdisj p hcl hpr
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of r p q
            (lca_contains_of_mem r p hpr) (lca_contains_of_mem r q hqr)
          have hlca' : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some b := lca_aux_right hAnone hb
          rw [hlca] at hlca'
          have hbb : a = b := by simpa using hlca'
          have har := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r b p (lca_aux_ancestor r p q b hb).1).1
          have hxnl : x ∉ view l := fun hh => hdisj x hh hxr
          have hbnl : b ∉ view l := fun hh => hdisj b hh har
          obtain ⟨dx', hdx'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome r x hxr
          obtain ⟨da', hda'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome r b har
          have e1 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (dx' + 1) :=
            lca_get_depth_right hv (lca_get_depth_eq_none l x hxnl) hdx'
          have hvb : ¬ (v = b) := by
            intro hvv
            rw [hvv] at hvr
            exact hvr har
          have e2 : get_depth (node v l r) b = some (da' + 1) :=
            lca_get_depth_right hvb (lca_get_depth_eq_none l b hbnl) hda'
          rw [hbb, e2] at hda
          rw [e1] at hdx
          have i1 : dx' + 1 = dx := by simpa using hdx
          have i2 : da' + 1 = da := by simpa using hda
          have i3 := ihr hdr b x dx' da' hb hxp hxq hdx' hda'
          omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem lowest_common_ancestor_postcond_satisfied (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) :
    lowest_common_ancestor_postcond root p q (lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of root p q h_precond.1 h_precond.2.1
  have hres : lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond = some a := ha

theorem lca_aux_hasQ_node (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).2.2 = ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2) := by
  first
  | (rw [lca_aux_node])
  | (simp [lca_aux_node])

theorem lca_aux_hasP (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.1 = tree_contains t p := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasP_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_aux_hasQ (t : Node) (p q : Nat) : (aux t p q).2.2 = tree_contains t q := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rw [lca_aux_nil, lca_tree_contains_nil]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [lca_aux_hasQ_node, ihl, ihr, lca_tree_contains_node]

theorem lca_mem_view_self (v : Nat) (l r : Node) : v ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]; simp

theorem lca_mem_view_left {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view l) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)

theorem lca_mem_view_right {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view r) :
    x ∈ view (node v l r) := by
  rw [lca_view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union]
  exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_mem_view_cases {x v : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : x ∈ view (node v l r)) :
    x = v ∨ x ∈ view l ∨ x ∈ view r := by
  rw [lca_view_node] at h
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
  tauto

theorem lca_contains_of_mem (t : Node) (x : Nat) : x ∈ view t → tree_contains t x = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihl h']; simp
    · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ihr h']; simp

theorem lca_mem_of_contains (t : Node) (x : Nat) : tree_contains t x = true → x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at h
    by_cases h1 : v = x
    · rw [← h1]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · by_cases h2 : tree_contains l x = true
      · exact lca_mem_view_left (ihl h2)
      · have e1 : (v == x) = false := by simp [h1]
        have e2 : tree_contains l x = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l x with
          | false => rfl
          | true => exact absurd hc h2
        rw [e1, e2] at h
        have h3 : tree_contains r x = true := by simpa using h
        exact lca_mem_view_right (ihr h3)

theorem lca_is_ancestor_mem (t : Node) (x y : Nat) :
    is_ancestor t x y → x ∈ view t ∧ y ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    exact ((lca_is_ancestor_nil x y).mp h).elim
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · rw [if_pos hv] at h
      refine ⟨?_, lca_mem_of_contains _ y h⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_mem_view_self v l r
    · rw [if_neg hv] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_left h1, lca_mem_view_left h2⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr h
        exact ⟨lca_mem_view_right h1, lca_mem_view_right h2⟩

theorem lca_is_ancestor_left {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor l x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_left (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inl h

theorem lca_is_ancestor_right {v x y : Nat} {l r : Node} (h : is_ancestor r x y) :
    is_ancestor (node v l r) x y := by
  rw [lca_is_ancestor_node]
  by_cases hv : v = x
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    exact lca_contains_of_mem _ y (lca_mem_view_right (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x y h).2)
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact Or.inr h

theorem lca_get_depth_isSome (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ view t → ∃ d, get_depth t x = some d := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro h
    rw [lca_view_nil] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [← hv]
      exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
    · rcases lca_mem_view_cases h with h' | h' | h'
      · exact absurd h'.symm hv
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihl h'
        exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hd⟩
      · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ihr h'
        cases hlx : get_depth l x with
        | some dl => exact ⟨dl + 1, lca_get_depth_left hv hlx⟩
        | none => exact ⟨d + 1, lca_get_depth_right hv hlx hd⟩

theorem lca_get_depth_eq_none (t : Node) (x : Nat) :
    x ∉ view t → get_depth t x = none := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro _; exact lca_get_depth_nil x
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    have h1 : ¬ (v = x) := by
      intro hv
      exact h (by rw [← hv]; exact lca_mem_view_self v l r)
    have h2 : x ∉ view l := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_left hh)
    have h3 : x ∉ view r := fun hh => h (lca_mem_view_right hh)
    exact lca_get_depth_none' h1 (ihl h2) (ihr h3)

theorem lca_band_left {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : a = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_band_right {a b : Bool} (h : (a && b) = true) : b = true := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem lca_aux_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat} (h : (aux l p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {p q a : Nat}
    (hA : (aux l p q).1 = none) (h : (aux r p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, h]
  simp

theorem lca_aux_isSome_of (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_contains t p = true → tree_contains t q = true → ∃ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro hp _
    rw [lca_tree_contains_nil] at hp
    exact absurd hp (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hp hq
    cases hA : (aux l p q).1 with
    | some a => exact ⟨a, lca_aux_left hA⟩
    | none =>
      cases hB : (aux r p q).1 with
      | some b => exact ⟨b, lca_aux_right hA hB⟩
      | none =>
        have hcond : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                      ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true := by
          rw [lca_aux_hasP l p q, lca_aux_hasP r p q, lca_aux_hasQ l p q, lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          rw [lca_tree_contains_node] at hp hq
          rw [hp, hq]
          simp
        refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
        rw [lca_aux_fst, hA, hB, hcond]
        simp

theorem lca_aux_cases (v : Nat) (l r : Node) (p q a : Nat)
    (h : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a) :
    (aux l p q).1 = some a ∨ (aux r p q).1 = some a ∨
      (a = v ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) p = true ∧ tree_contains (node v l r) q = true) := by
  rw [lca_aux_fst] at h
  by_cases h1 : ((aux l p q).1).isSome = true
  · rw [if_pos h1] at h
    exact Or.inl h
  · rw [if_neg h1] at h
    by_cases h2 : ((aux r p q).1).isSome = true
    · rw [if_pos h2] at h
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · rw [if_neg h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : (((v == p) || (aux l p q).2.1 || (aux r p q).2.1) &&
                     ((v == q) || (aux l p q).2.2 || (aux r p q).2.2)) = true
      · rw [if_pos h3] at h
        refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by simpa using h.symm, ?_, ?_⟩)
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasP l p q, ← lca_aux_hasP r p q]
          exact lca_band_left h3
        · rw [lca_tree_contains_node, ← lca_aux_hasQ l p q, ← lca_aux_hasQ r p q]
          exact lca_band_right h3
      · rw [if_neg h3] at h
        exact absurd h (by simp)

theorem lca_aux_ancestor (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    ∀ a, (aux t p q).1 = some a → is_ancestor t a p ∧ is_ancestor t a q := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro a h
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro a h
    rcases lca_aux_cases v l r p q a h with hc | hc | ⟨hav, hcp, hcq⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihl a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_left h1, lca_is_ancestor_left h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ihr a hc
      exact ⟨lca_is_ancestor_right h1, lca_is_ancestor_right h2⟩
    · constructor
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcp
      · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node, if_pos hav.symm]
        exact hcq

theorem lca_aux_lowest (t : Node) (p q : Nat) :
    tree_distinct t → ∀ a x dx da, (aux t p q).1 = some a →
      is_ancestor t x p → is_ancestor t x q →
      get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t a = some da → dx ≤ da := by
  induction t with
  | nil =>
    intro _ a x dx da h _ _ _ _
    rw [lca_aux_nil_fst] at h
    exact absurd h (by simp)
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro hdist a x dx da hlca hxp hxq hdx hda
    rw [lca_tree_distinct_node] at hdist
    obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hdist
    have hdisj : ∀ y, y ∈ view l → y ∈ view r → False := by
      intro y hy1 hy2
      have hmem : y ∈ view l ∩ view r := Set.mem_inter hy1 hy2
      rw [hlr] at hmem
      simp at hmem
    by_cases hv : v = x
    · have h0 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some 0 := by
        rw [← hv]
        exact lca_get_depth_self v l r
      rw [h0] at hdx
      have hdx0 : 0 = dx := by simpa using hdx
      omega
    · rw [lca_is_ancestor_node] at hxp hxq
      rw [if_neg hv] at hxp hxq
      rcases hxp with hxp | hxp
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · have hxl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1
          have hpl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).2
          have hql := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).2
          obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of l p q
            (lca_contains_of_mem l p hpl) (lca_contains_of_mem l q hql)
          have hlca' : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some a' := lca_aux_left ha'
          rw [hlca] at hlca'
          have haa : a = a' := by simpa using hlca'
          have hal := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l a' p (lca_aux_ancestor l p q a' ha').1).1
          obtain ⟨dx', hdx'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l x hxl
          obtain ⟨da', hda'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome l a' hal
          have e1 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (dx' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hv hdx'
          have hva : ¬ (v = a') := by
            intro hvv
            rw [hvv] at hvl
            exact hvl hal
          have e2 : get_depth (node v l r) a' = some (da' + 1) := lca_get_depth_left hva hda'
          rw [haa, e2] at hda
          rw [e1] at hdx
          have i1 : dx' + 1 = dx := by simpa using hdx
          have i2 : da' + 1 = da := by simpa using hda
          have i3 := ihl hdl a' x dx' da' ha' hxp hxq hdx' hda'
          omega
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x p hxp).1 hh)
      · rcases hxq with hxq | hxq
        · exact absurd (lca_is_ancestor_mem l x q hxq).1
            (fun hh => hdisj x hh (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1)
        · have hxr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).1
          have hpr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x p hxp).2
          have hqr := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r x q hxq).2
          have hAnone : (aux l p q).1 = none := by
            cases hcase : (aux l p q).1 with
            | none => rfl
            | some c =>
              exfalso
              have hcl := (lca_is_ancestor_mem l c p (lca_aux_ancestor l p q c hcase).1).2
              exact hdisj p hcl hpr
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of r p q
            (lca_contains_of_mem r p hpr) (lca_contains_of_mem r q hqr)
          have hlca' : (aux (node v l r) p q).1 = some b := lca_aux_right hAnone hb
          rw [hlca] at hlca'
          have hbb : a = b := by simpa using hlca'
          have har := (lca_is_ancestor_mem r b p (lca_aux_ancestor r p q b hb).1).1
          have hxnl : x ∉ view l := fun hh => hdisj x hh hxr
          have hbnl : b ∉ view l := fun hh => hdisj b hh har
          obtain ⟨dx', hdx'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome r x hxr
          obtain ⟨da', hda'⟩ := lca_get_depth_isSome r b har
          have e1 : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (dx' + 1) :=
            lca_get_depth_right hv (lca_get_depth_eq_none l x hxnl) hdx'
          have hvb : ¬ (v = b) := by
            intro hvv
            rw [hvv] at hvr
            exact hvr har
          have e2 : get_depth (node v l r) b = some (da' + 1) :=
            lca_get_depth_right hvb (lca_get_depth_eq_none l b hbnl) hda'
          rw [hbb, e2] at hda
          rw [e1] at hdx
          have i1 : dx' + 1 = dx := by simpa using hdx
          have i2 : da' + 1 = da := by simpa using hda
          have i3 := ihr hdr b x dx' da' hb hxp hxq hdx' hda'
          omega

theorem lowest_common_ancestor_postcond_satisfied (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) :
    lowest_common_ancestor_postcond root p q (lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := lca_aux_isSome_of root p q h_precond.1 h_precond.2.1
  have hres : lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond = some a := ha
  rw [hres]
  refine ⟨(lca_aux_ancestor root p q a ha).1, (lca_aux_ancestor root p q a ha).2, ?_⟩
  intro x hx1 hx2
  cases hgx : get_depth root x with
  | none => first | trivial | simp
  | some dx =>
    cases hga : get_depth root a with
    | none => first | trivial | simp
    | some da =>
      exact lca_aux_lowest root p q h_precond.2.2 a x dx da ha hx1 hx2 hgx hga
  -- !benchmark @end proof

analysis:
The student does implement an LCA algorithm from scratch over a user-defined binary tree, and does not appear to use any cheating mechanism such as `sorry`, `admit`, empty bodies, or delegating to an existing library LCA function.

Algorithmically, the core function is:

- `aux : Node → Nat → Nat → Option Nat × Bool × Bool`
- It recursively traverses the tree.
- For each subtree, it computes:
  - a candidate LCA if already found below,
  - whether `p` occurs in the subtree,
  - whether `q` occurs in the subtree.
- At a node:
  - if the left subtree already found an LCA, it returns that;
  - else if the right subtree already found one, it returns that;
  - else if the current subtree contains both `p` and `q`, it returns the current node value.

This is a standard recursive LCA strategy for binary trees with distinct values.

I also checked whether the left-priority / right-priority behavior could violate the “lowest” requirement. It does not: if a subtree already contains an LCA for both targets, that LCA is necessarily deeper than the current node and should be returned. Because values are distinct and the left/right views are disjoint under the distinctness assumption, both targets cannot simultaneously have valid LCAs in both left and right subtrees. So the prioritization is not an implementation bug.

The main function `lowest_common_ancestor` simply returns `(aux root p q).1`, which is consistent with the intended algorithm.

On cheating/trickiness:
- No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or placeholders.
- No use of an existing built-in/tree-library LCA solver.
- No empty implementation.
- The code contains many helper lemmas and proofs, but they are all explicit.
